entries.name: Reactor Core
entries.desc: More energy per second, and a warmer hull.

entries.name: Capacitor Bank
entries.desc: A deeper energy pool for beam work and boosting.

entries.name: Shield Booster
entries.desc: Bigger, faster-recovering shield. Needs Shield Lattice tech at the yard.

entries.name: Heavy Plating
entries.desc: Armour you can feel in the throttle.

entries.name: Afterburner
entries.desc: Stronger boost. The heat is not subtle.

entries.name: Fuel Cell
entries.desc: Extra tank. Fewer stops, longer hauls.

entries.name: Hyper Coil
entries.desc: Reaches the long hyperlanes that stock drives cannot span.

entries.name: Sensor Array
entries.desc: Wider scan band, longer scan reach and half the bearing error on signal readings.

entries.name: Heat Sinks
entries.desc: Finned brass that sheds heat faster.

entries.name: Missile Rack
entries.desc: Six more missiles on the rail.

entries.name: Decoy Launcher
entries.desc: Four more flares to spend against locks.

entries.name: Beam Lens
entries.desc: Stronger overcharge on the beam. Heats faster while it fires.

entries.name: Lock Computer
entries.desc: Missile locks in 60% of the time.

entries.name: Gyro Stabilizer
entries.desc: Faster turns for tight circling fights.
